records.tagline: Free global M&A deal intelligence from SEC EDGAR Filings
records.description: mergers.news tracks 5,000+ mergers and acquisitions directly from SEC EDGAR regulatory filings, Search dels by company, sector, value, and region, spanning from 1993 to present.

records.name: ARTIFY
records.tagline: Transform memories in your phone into art for your home.
records.description: Artify lets your customers create a personalised art experience in your shop with artist-led styles, custom canvas prints, and fully automated fulfilment. Seamless onboarding: Artists earn upto 90% royalties each time their style is used to transform a customer photo into wall art. Merchants can earn 15% commission on all frame & credit sales via Shopify Collective Customers can choose art style, frame type and frame colour then view in AR before purchasing.

records.name: Grow a Garden Calculator
records.tagline: Roblox Grow a Garden farmers. Stack mutations.
records.description: The most powerful free toolkit for Roblox Grow a Garden. Calculate crop profits, stack mutations, track live prices, set harvest timers, and dominate with tier lists.

records.name: يفي
records.tagline: AI powered WhatsApp Platform for customer engagement.
records.description: يفي: منصتك الذكية لإنجاز الأعمال عبر واتساب. سهّل تواصلك مع عملائك، أتمتة المهام، وحقق المزيد من الإنتاجية من خلال حلول واتساب المتقدمة! Yafe is a Saudi-based WhatsApp Business Platform that helps organizations automate customer communications, manage conversations, deploy AI-powered chatbots, and improve customer engagement through WhatsApp.

records.name: AgentGate
records.tagline: Agent-aware LLM cost tracking for small teams.
records.description: Lightweight LLM gateway for teams of 5-50, without Enterprise pricing. ① Per-task cost trees, not flat logs See Task → 30 calls across 3 models → $0.47 total. Not just a bill. ② New models work on day one Transparent proxy. OpenAI-compatible models route instantly. No waiting. ③ Team controls included Usage alerts, rate limiting, data export. No "contact sales" wall. Waitlist live. Built for teams who've outgrown hacky scripts but can't justify $500/mo plans.

records.name: AMZ History Reviews AI - Home & Kitchen
records.tagline: AI Amazon review analyzer based on years of history data.
records.description: Stop scrolling through fake reviews. Most tools only analyze what's on the page today. Our AI-powered Chrome extension leverages a comprehensive repository of historical Amazon data to read between the lines. Key Features: • Fake Review Detection: Spot review manipulation by tracking historical patterns. • Dynamic Pros & Cons: AI-distilled product insights across timelines. • Built for 3 Worlds: Smart shopping for buyers, competitor tracking for sellers, and market research for devs.

records.name: LocalDiff for Windows
records.tagline: Compare files & folders offline — fast, private, beautiful
records.description: LocalDiff is a faLocalDiff is a desktop app for developers who need to compare files without uploading code to random websites. Compare any two files side-by-side, diff entire folders, or paste text directly. Everything runs locally — no internet, no account, no subscription. One-time $10 · Windows · Export HTML reportsst, beautiful desktop app that shows you exactly what changed between two files, two folders, or any pasted text — all processed locally o...

records.name: Build Club Campus
records.tagline: Virtual AI School: Upskill in AI and Become Great at it Fast
records.description: Build Club Campus is a fun, gamified and community-driven virtual AI school for learning AI by building with it. Static courses get old fast in AI, so Campus helps you stay current through bite-sized courses, real projects, role-based use cases and community templates that evolve with the tools. Earn certifications in OpenAI, Claude, Copilot and more, and become great at AI fast - for work, startups or side hustles. It’s 100% free, as part of our mission to enable anyone to build with AI.

records.name: Sun
records.tagline: Collaborative voice API for agents
records.description: Sun is a voice first AI model built specifically for real‑time collaborative voice interaction, not just one‑on‑one chat. ChatGPT Realtime and Gemini Live were built for one user talking to AI. Sun is built for collaboration — meetings, group calls, multi-agent debates, classrooms. One API, multi-speaker awareness, 10× the context window.

records.name: Dressed / Daily
records.tagline: Your wardrobe, the weather, one outfit.
records.description: Most people wear 20% of their wardrobe 80% of the time — not because they don't own better clothes, but because they forget they own them. Dressed / Daily reads your wardrobe and the weather, then picks a complete outfit every morning. Photo each item once, AI fills in the details. Tap Generate. Get dressed. Won't pair stripes with stripes. Won't suggest linen in rain. Knows what's in the wash.

records.name: TokenAtlas
records.tagline: Real-time control of AI infrastructure costs
records.description: TokenAtlas is an AI FinOps control center built for teams running AI workloads. Unlike generic cloud cost tools, it is designed specifically for AI infrastructure, where usage is dynamic and model-based. It unifies AI spending, usage, and performance data into one real-time dashboard, helping teams understand costs by model, feature, and usage patterns, and optimize AI spend with actionable insights.

records.name: Chloe by Close
records.tagline: AI agent built into your CRM who works leads for you
records.description: Other AI agents bolt onto your CRM, but Chloe is built into it. Chloe calls leads, replies to emails, enriches contacts, takes notes, and updates Close the second anything changes. No extra seat, no commission, no integration to babysit. Chloe isn't a tool you add. It's like adding 20 salespeople who never sleep, directly in your CRM. Chloe works across your entire sales motion — but her voice is where she really goes to work. Hear Chloe sell now.

records.name: VisaroCV
records.tagline: AI-powered CV builder with ATS-ready templates. Free.
records.description: Free AI CV builder with 10 ATS-ready templates. Create a professional CV in minutes — AI writing, job-fit scoring, PDF export. Used in 40+ countries.

records.name: Humanonn
records.tagline: Make your site feel more human
records.description: most tools give generic audits. humanonn specifically answers "why my site look vibe coded." it crawls your live site, captures hover states, interaction effects, screenshots... maps everything against tiered signals split into origin signals (only ai generates these) and polish signals (things any dev misses). that origin vs polish split is the difference. it tells you "your buttons are pill shaped because lovable defaulted them." nothing else does that. it also says what to be fixed and how.

records.name: Novus
records.tagline: Catch and fix usability issues automatically as you ship
records.description: Novus is the product agent built for teams that ship fast. Connect your codebase and Novus automatically instruments, analyzes, and improves your product — no manual setup. It monitors continuously, flags usability issues proactively, and delivers intelligence for engineers and PMs.

records.name: AI Localizer
records.tagline: AI-powered localization for Xcode apps
records.description: AI Localizer helps iOS and macOS developers translate Xcode projects into 35+ languages with just a few clicks. Automatically detect localizable strings - works with SwiftUI, Storyboard, XIB, and bothstrings &xcstrings formats. Translate using powerful AI, or configure your own Microsoft Azure or Google Translate account from this dedicated macOS app. Export translations for proofreading, re-import changes instantly, make manual edits, and keep your data private with local-first processing.

records.name: Unimind — Intelligence Infrastructure
records.tagline: Verify any content for misinformation, manipulation or fraud
records.description: Unimind is a multimodal AI engine that analyzes the kind of content where misinformation and fraud actually spread: WhatsApp forwards, Instagram Reels, screenshots, voice notes, and short videos. It reads text, OCRs images, listens to audio, and reasons over video to flag misinformation, manipulation, or scam signals in seconds. Built for Hindi, English, and Hinglish, Unimind focuses on clear verdicts and grounded explanations, not vibes.

records.name: Revo Racers
records.tagline: India's First Esports Racing Platform
records.description: Revo Racers is India's first dedicated racing esports platform, bringing together sim racers, gaming enthusiasts, and competitive drivers. Participate in online racing tournaments, compete on global tracks, climb leaderboards, earn certificates and rewards, and showcase your racing skills in a growing esports community. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced racer, Revo Racers provides a platform to race, compete, and connect with fellow motorsport enthusiasts.

records.name: PassGen Secret Vault IOS
records.tagline: PassGen Secret Vault For IOS
records.description: Secure local-first password vault for iPhone with Face ID unlock, passkey support, encrypted backups, and built-in password generator. PassGen Vault helps you store and manage passwords securely on iPhone with a fast, mobile-first experience. Features: Local encrypted vault Face ID and device passcode unlock Password generator Passkey-ready login support Optional Sign in with Apple and Google Encrypted backup tools Cloud plan support for secure sync workflows

records.name: DashVox
records.tagline: Voice-control coding agents from your watch or car
records.description: DashVox lets you run coding agents like Claude Code or Codex on your own machine, by voice, from your phone, car (CarPlay/Android Auto), or Apple Watch. Speak a task, it runs over SSH on your real machine, and the reply comes back through your earbuds. Message queuing lets you keep talking while sessions run. Self-hostable (no account needed, your data can stay on your machine), bring your own LLM keys, and free. Built to code hands-free, away from the desk.

records.name: IGSendMail
records.tagline: AI email marketing with unlimited subscribers & verification
records.description: AI-powered email marketing with unlimited subscribers and built-in verification. Manage campaigns from Claude via MCP. Subject line generator, copy optimizer, automation, and analytics — all included. Free plan, paid from $19/mo.

records.name: Maths3D
records.tagline: Real Maths. Real Places.
records.description: Interactive 3D geometry and trigonometry for NCEA, Singapore MOE, and US Common Core. Visualisation of the surface areas of hollow, open and closed 3D platonic shapes. Animated derivations of volumes of pyramids, cones, prisms and cylinders. Pythagoras Theorem, Trigonometric Ratios in Right Angled Triangles, Sine Rules, Cosine Rules and Sine Area of Triangles in the Wonders of the World.and National landmarks of New Zealand, Singapore and the United States. Free for students.

records.name: Chromme
records.tagline: Level up by doing your actual work
records.description: Chromme turns your everyday browsing into a role-playing game. Every keystroke, click, and scroll earns XP, gold, and loot — while you do your real work. Gear up, raid websites as bosses, clear daily quests, and unlock achievements. Privacy-first: it counts how much you do, never what you type. All local.

records.name: enchanted.app
records.tagline: A Free BaZi Calculator - no sign-ups required
records.description: Calculate your free BaZi (八字) chart from your exact birth date and hour. Identify your Day Master, lucky element, and Five Elements interactions. No signup.

records.name: AI Music Video Generator
records.tagline: Supports 10s to 5min music
records.description: AIMakeSong is an AI music video generator from audio file. Upload a song, pick visuals, and export with lip sync, subtitles, and multiple ratios.Most Al video tools max out at 15 seconds and charge a premium. AlMakeSong generates full-length MVs up to 5 minutes - real commercial-grade videos worth publishing. Just make a song, upload your photos (love story, wedding, birthday, anime, any scene), and the Al matches visuals to your music automatically. No editing. No timeline. Just export.

records.name: DoomClicks
records.tagline: 50 tiny useless websites to cure your boredom
records.description: 50 tiny single-page websites built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JS. Each one does exactly one silly thing — quiz yourself on how miserable you are, generate an evil plan, talk to a toaster, or just play snake. They're all connected with a random site picker. No accounts, no installs, just click and go.

records.name: The Client Onboarding Blueprint
records.tagline: Automate your client intake in 30 minutes — no coding needed
records.description: Most business owners don't lose clients from bad service — they lose them from slow follow-ups and inconsistent onboarding. The Client Onboarding Blueprint gives you a beginner-friendly automation guide + a pre-built n8n workflow you import in one click. When a new client submits your form, it automatically saves their details, creates their folder, sends a welcome email, notifies you, and schedules a follow-up. No coding. No expensive tools. Made in South Africa. Built for the world.

records.name: Walrus Memory
records.tagline: Enable agents to keep context & work across apps + sessions
records.description: Walrus Memory enables AI agents to operate reliably across apps and sessions, without losing context. Portable, verifiable, and fully controlled by you, it is the memory layer that lets agents handle complex workflows and coordinate using data they can trust.
